categories.main_business_segments: Silkroad Visual Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in digital visual comprehensive services based on CG creativity and technology. Its main business segments include digital exhibition and display comprehensive services, digital content application, smart city and digital twin solutions, AR/VR/MR interactive digital content solutions, and cloud rendering services. The company serves government agencies, urban developers, enterprises across various industries, and commercial clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced computer graphics (CG) technology, including 3D modeling, animation, virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), mixed reality (MR), artificial intelligence (AI), and cloud computing. It develops integrated physical interaction systems, wireless charging LED display systems, AI-generated content (AIGC), and digital twin platforms. The company also utilizes Unreal Engine for high-performance rendering and projection fusion technologies to create immersive digital experiences.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Silkroad Visual serves government institutions, urban planners, cultural venues (museums, science centers), real estate developers, industrial clients, educational institutions, and commercial enterprises. Its markets include digital exhibitions, cultural tourism, industrial digital transformation, education, and smart city projects. The company also targets emerging markets in metaverse content and consumer-end digital content applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with branches in Shenzhen, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Nanjing, Wuhan, Chengdu, Qingdao, Zhuhai, Hainan, Kunming, Tianjin, Chongqing, Hefei, and Hong Kong. It also has subsidiaries in the United States and serves clients in over 50 countries through its cloud rendering platform. The majority of revenue is generated from the South China region, followed by East and North China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Silkroad Visual operates primarily in the midstream of the digital cultural industry supply chain, providing digital creative design, content production, and visual presentation services. It sources foundational software and hardware from upstream suppliers and delivers solutions to downstream sectors such as gaming, film, VR/AR, industrial manufacturing, online education, and government public services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes 'culture + technology' integration, focusing on enhancing digital content creativity, technological innovation, and application expansion. It invests in R&D for AI-driven content generation, immersive VR/AR/MR experiences, digital twin and smart city platforms, and cloud rendering technologies. Silkroad Visual also pursues product and service upgrades, internal management optimization, and expansion into consumer-end markets through partnerships with smart wearable device manufacturers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based service contracts involving digital exhibition design and implementation, digital content production, and integrated digital solutions. The company also earns income from cloud rendering services and licensing of proprietary software tools. Revenue is recognized based on contract progress or upon delivery of service outcomes, with no significant reliance on product sales or subscription models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Silkroad Visual is a leading player in China's digital creative industry, recognized for its strong CG technology capabilities and extensive project experience. It holds a dominant market share in cloud rendering services domestically and maintains competitive advantages through its integrated creative and technological solutions. The company faces competition from other digital content providers but benefits from scale, brand reputation, and government collaborations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Silkroad Visual reported a significant revenue decline of approximately 59% to 588 million RMB, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 364 million RMB, reflecting a challenging year with project delays and reduced government spending. Total assets stood at 1.8 billion RMB, with equity of 588 million RMB. Despite short-term setbacks, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in R&D, positioning for recovery and growth aligned with industry digital transformation trends.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by combining high-quality cultural content with cutting-edge digital technologies to create immersive, interactive visual experiences. Its comprehensive service offerings cover the entire digital creative process, from design to delivery, supported by proprietary technologies and a strong creative team. Silkroad Visual emphasizes innovation in AI integration, digital twin applications, and immersive VR/AR solutions, aiming to enhance cultural influence and economic value for clients across government, commercial, and consumer sectors.
